World model (revised — key breakthrough):
- The icon is a full 6×6 encoding of all 8 surrounding tiles: each 2×2 arm = edge tile, each 2×2 corner block = corner tile, with R→W and b→g. Verified against all 3 references (my earlier "contradiction" was a miscount of poolA's MR, which is b, not R).
- Target icon (WWgggg/WWRRWW/WWgggg) decodes to: TL=R, TR=b, BL=R, BR=b, TM=b, ML=R, MR=R, BM=b.
- Current target: TL=b ✗, BL=b ✗ — everything else already matches.
- Yellow bar = toggle counter (HUD), not correctness.
- Plan: click TL (38,38) and BL (54,38) in one batch to complete the target panel.
